description: Phenotype frequency spectrum of DOCK11 deficiency from HPO annotations
code:
import requests, json, pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

d=requests.get("https://ontology.jax.org/api/network/annotation/OMIM%3A301109",timeout=60).json()
rows=[]
for cat,items in d["categories"].items():
    for it in items:
        f=it["metadata"].get("frequency","")
        if "/" not in f: continue
        k,n=f.split("/"); k=int(k); n=int(n)
        rows.append({"category":cat,"term":it["name"],"hpo":it["id"],"k":k,"n":n,"pct":100*k/n})
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
df=df[~df.category.isin(["Clinical course"])]

# Wilson 95% CI
def wilson(k,n,z=1.96):
    p=k/n; den=1+z**2/n
    c=(p+z**2/(2*n))/den
    h=z*np.sqrt(p*(1-p)/n+z**2/(4*n**2))/den
    return 100*(c-h),100*(c+h)
df[["lo","hi"]]=df.apply(lambda r: pd.Series(wilson(r.k,r.n)),axis=1)

df=df.sort_values(["pct","n"],ascending=[True,True])
colors={"Blood and blood-forming tissues":"#c0392b","Immunology":"#2874a6","Digestive System":"#1e8449",
        "Cardiovascular":"#8e44ad","Cellular phenotype":"#d68910","Growth":"#7f8c8d",
        "Connective tissue":"#16a085","Head and neck":"#b03a2e","Skeletal system":"#5d6d7e",
        "Genitourinary system":"#884ea0","Ear":"#935116","Musculature":"#117a65","Respiratory System":"#1f618d"}

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,13))
y=np.arange(len(df))
ax.barh(y,df.pct,color=[colors.get(c,"#555") for c in df.category],edgecolor="none")
ax.errorbar(df.pct,y,xerr=[df.pct-df.lo,df.hi-df.pct],fmt="none",ecolor="#333",elinewidth=0.8,capsize=2)
ax.set_yticks(y)
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{t}  ({h})" for t,h in zip(df.term,df.hpo)],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("Frequency among reported DOCK11-deficient patients (%), 95% Wilson CI")
ax.set_title("ADMIDX (DOCK11 deficiency, OMIM:301109): HPO phenotype frequencies\nfrom the two index cohorts, PMID 36952639 (n=8) and PMID 37342957 (n=4)",fontsize=11)
for yi,(p,k,n) in enumerate(zip(df.pct,df.k,df.n)):
    ax.text(min(p+ (df.hi-df.pct).iloc[yi] +2,104),yi,f"{k}/{n}",va="center",fontsize=7,color="#222")
handles=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=colors[c]) for c in df.category.unique()]
ax.legend(handles,df.category.unique(),fontsize=7,loc="lower right",frameon=False)
ax.set_xlim(0,118); ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
